newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy values off on technical sales.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy values off on technical sales.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices eased in a lightly traded ACCESS session Tuesday, under pressure from refiners who sold off crude to take advantage of the heating oil-to-crude crack spread, brokers said.
The American Petroleum Institute (API) announced it would delay the release its weekly inventory data until Wednesday.
After February crude expired, the March NYMEX contract eased seven cents a barrel overnight to $24.15.
"There's a little crack spread short covering," a trader said, explanation the heavier selling of crude.
Activity stood at 500 lots traded in March and 800 overall in March crude.
NYMEX February heating oil edged down 66.03 cents a gallon, with about 25 lots traded in the front month and 70 traded overall.
Gasoline futures edged up 0.06 cents a gallon to 67.50 cents with 64 tp 100.
